summary: Ephemeral assertion 'aud' rotation breaks internal impersonator service token issuance
description:
Issue summary:
Users are unable to request ephemeral impersonation tokens via the internal impersonator service (used by runbook-runner and developer CLI) after a change to the IdP audience values. The impersonator service rejects IdP assertions during token-exchange with 'invalid_audience' errors. Impact is limited to internal tooling that requests short-lived service tokens; interactive console login is unaffected.

Impact:
- On-call runbook-runner tasks that rely on ephemeral tokens fail to start (failed job executions).
- Developer CLI commands that trigger impersonation exits with 401 during token-exchange.
- A subset of service automated tests that depend on impersonation are failing.

Context:
- Change observed after IdP (Okta) audience claim rollout on 2026-03-09 (internal announcement received).
- Identity-proxy validates 'aud' strictly against a single configured value. The IdP now issues either a new audience string or rotates audience order based on client metadata.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use developer CLI to call 'redwood impersonate --service runbook-runner --ttl 300'
2) CLI performs OIDC assertion exchange via identity-proxy to authz-service
3) identity-proxy validates incoming JWT 'aud' against configured audience and rejects if mismatch
4) Error returned to CLI: HTTP 401 - invalid_audience
logs:
2026-03-11T14:12:07Z identity-proxy ERROR token-exchange: validation failed: invalid_audience
  token.aud: ["api://runbook"]
  expected aud: "urn:redwood:impersonator"
Sample decoded assertion (redacted): header:{alg:RS256}, payload:{iss:"https://okta.example.com", sub:"svc-impersonator", aud:["urn:redwood:impersonator", "api://runbook"], iat:167, exp:527}
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: Okta announced audience canonicalization change (ticket from SSO team) which resulted in additional audience entries and/or reordering; identity-proxy code assumes single-string aud comparison and treats any list difference as mismatch.

Verified reproduction in staging by simulating assertion with aud array ordering swapped; identity-proxy rejects when aud array != configured single string, even if expected value present in the array.
Authz-service logs show token-exchange attempts from impersonator service with correlation id 0a3f9c; identity-proxy returned 401 before authz-service evaluated scopes.
Confirmed change in IdP behavior: admin@idp confirms rollout of multi-audience tokens to support third-party integrations (Okta change request #OKTA-7781).
Risk analysis: This regression affects only clients that perform strict aud equality checks; broad customer-facing APIs still use audience forms unaffected (no public customer impact).
comments: Aisha Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Noticed failures during late-night runbook execution window; attaching CLI trace and sample assertion. Escalating because on-call automation is blocked.
Diego Martinez (Assignee) 2026-03-10: Ack'd. Reproduced locally by constructing JWTs with extra aud entries. Starting root-cause triage with identity-proxy owners.

SRE Oncall (Lina Chen) 2026-03-11: Temporary mitigation applied: identity-proxy config updated to accept comma-separated audiences including 'api://runbook' which unblocked most runners. Need a code fix to handle arrays properly.
SSO Team (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-11: Confirmed Okta audience rollout; patch scheduled to be delayed upstream, but we recommend server-side fix to be robust to aud arrays. Filed OKTA-7781 for tracking.
Diego Martinez 2026-03-12: Implemented quick patch in staging that treats aud claim as list membership check (PR linked). Running canary on staging impersonator flows.
resolution:
Workaround: temporarily extended identity-proxy audience whitelist to include both legacy and new Okta audience entries (config change) which restored impersonator token-exchange for affected services.

Permanent fix: identity-proxy code PR merged to treat 'aud' as either string or array and validate membership instead of strict equality (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/412). Added unit tests for aud array permutations and an integration test against a mocked Okta that emits multi-audience tokens.

Follow-ups: update runbook to include a verification step after IdP audience changes; add automated Canary that runs impersonator token-exchange post-SAML/Okta config changes. Plan to release patched identity-proxy to prod on 2026-03-13 during low-traffic window.
